sources.title: Behemoth-ReduX-123B-v1c-Q3_K_M_GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Card for Behemoth-ReduX-123B-v1c-GGUF I just made this so I could fit it on my GPU with a little more room for comfort. I had to quantize from their Q5_K_M. This is in theory bad, according to llama.cpp. So much so they require a flag to allow it. In practice though, this isn't the case.
